bundled.built_from: Unmodified strawberry-1.2.31/data/schema/schema.sql copied from the official strawberry-1.2.31.tar.xz source release.

modifications: The upstream executable and source archive are unchanged. A separate launcher initializes normal configuration and the upstream database schema, then executes the product. A separate process guard confines writes to profile/document directories and restricts child executables; upstream files remain unchanged.
configuration: XDG configuration and data directories are below DATA_DIR. A fresh profile has one empty playlist, PBP_COLLECTION_DIR as its collection folder, and the first-run sponsorship message disabled; playback uses the supplied PulseAudio sink.

notes.process_isolation: process_guard.c is compiled at installation; requires Linux Landlock. Native helper execution is limited to the installed runtime; Python applications cannot launch external executables.
